plan: Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit. Assuming others bid near their values, a bid around $20 may be optimal. This allows potential profit if the third-highest bid is lower. I must avoid overbidding and paying more than my item's value.

Given my value of $9, I aim to bid low to ensure a profit if I win. My maximum bid should be below $9 to guarantee a profit. A bid slightly above the average expected third-highest bid (e.g., $5) could be strategic, ensuring a profit if I win. The other bidders are rational and may bid closer to their values, so I anticipate bids around $20-$30. I will bid $6 to maximize potential profit while minimizing the risk of overbidding.

Given my value of $13, I should aim to bid below this to ensure profit if I win. Bidding too high risks paying more than the item's value. Other bidders will likely bid close to their values. To win, I need to outbid them but still pay below my value. A bid of $10 positions me competitively, as it is close enough to my value to potentially secure a win without risking overpayment.
